meta.title: AI Action Translator
meta.description: Turns an agent's tool calls into beginner-friendly explanations, one numbered step at a time: which tool ran, which file it touched, which layer of the project it sits in — plus a read-only action timeline, term cards, a failure book, a pre-flight risk guard, a multi-agent roster, and learning drills, so learners can follow what the AI is doing, why, and how to change course mid-way.
